about: Public sources behind the SOP, skills, and precheck kit. Each quote must appear on the live page. Run `node scripts/check-sources.mjs --write` to re-verify and regenerate reference/sources.md.

sources.title: Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL: Upgrade the database major version in-place
sources.supports: In-place MVU mechanics and limits: uses pg_upgrade, deletes logical slots, extension floors for 18, blocking flags, large-object and database-count limits, relation-count reliability, precheck and upgrade timeouts, cancel window, replica rules, rollback through a recovery instance, ANALYZE afterwards. Automatic pre- and post-upgrade backups; pg_squeeze floors; rules for replicas left out of the upgrade.
quotes: deletes all existing logical replication slots
For PostgreSQL 18, upgrade to PostGIS version 3.6.0
more than 10 million large objects, then the upgrade fails
Returns a timeout error if not finished within three hours
Returns a timeout error if not finished within six hours
You can only cancel during the main upgrade phase
you can't use the Google Cloud console or Terraform
recovery instance, which is a new instance running the pre-upgrade version
unexpected request for new relfilenumber in binary upgrade mode
Run ANALYZE on your primary instance
upgrade the pg_squeeze extension for all of your databases to version 1.6, 1.7, or 1.8 respectively
you must upgrade the read replicas before you upgrade the primary instance
After you upgrade a replica, you can't roll back the database version of the replica
Cloud SQL automatically makes two on-demand backups, called upgrade backups
which is made immediately before starting the upgrade
you can't cancel the major version upgrade
Check generated columns from unlogged tables

sources.title: Database Migration Service: Known limitations (PostgreSQL)
sources.supports: Logical-path limits: keyless tables, unlogged tables, large objects, sequences. Materialized views arrive empty; backups and PITR are suspended until promotion.
quotes: UPDATE and DELETE statements aren't migrated for tables without primary keys
UNLOGGED and TEMPORARY tables aren't and can't be replicated
Sequence values are synchronized during the final promotion step
doesn't migrate data from materialized views, just the view schema
Automated backups and point-in-time recovery (PITR) are suspended during continuous replication
primary keys aren't required to replicate UPDATE and DELETE operations if you set the replica identity to INDEX or FULL

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18: pg_upgrade
sources.supports: pg_upgrade 18 carries most optimizer statistics but not extended, extension, or cumulative statistics; adds --swap.
quotes: custom statistics added by an extension, or statistics collected by the cumulative statistics system

sources.supports: --missing-stats-only needs superuser-restricted catalogs; --analyze-in-stages can make plans transiently worse when stats exist.

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18: ANALYZE
sources.supports: ANALYZE silently skips tables the caller can't analyze.
quotes: will skip over any tables that the calling user does not have permission to analyze
database owners are allowed to analyze all tables in their databases

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 release notes
sources.supports: 18 incompatibilities: MD5 deprecation, VACUUM/ANALYZE recursion, COPY CSV end marker, unlogged partitioned tables, AFTER trigger role, checksum default, full-text and pg_trgm reindex on non-libc clusters, PK/FK collation rule, idle_replication_slot_timeout.
quotes: Change VACUUM and ANALYZE to process the inheritance children of a parent
Execute AFTER triggers as the role that was active when trigger events were queued
pg_upgrade requires matching cluster checksum settings
recommended to reindex all indexes related to full-text search and pg_trgm
Require primary/foreign key relationships to use either deterministic collations

sources.title: pg_upgrade check.c (REL_18_STABLE)
sources.supports: Checks pg_upgrade 18 runs: NOT NULL inheritance, aclitem and reg* types, prepared transactions, datallowconn, output_plugin_libraries. Its data-type check covers tables, materialized views and indexes.
quotes: Your installation contains inconsistent NOT NULL constraints
The source cluster contains prepared transactions
pg_database.datallowconn must be true and pg_database.datconnlimit
Checking for system-defined composite types in user tables
